# Citation

The 1001 Genomes Consortium (genomes). *1,135 genomes reveal the global pattern of polymorphism in Arabidopsis thaliana*. Cell. DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2016.05.063. Source: [https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/1503762/](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/1503762/).

# One-Sentence Summary

Reports a large Arabidopsis thaliana genome panel that supports studies of natural variation, population structure, and haplotype diversity.

# Scope for simitall

Use as a data-source reference when an agent or user asks for an Arabidopsis 1001 Genomes-derived panel. The agent must request an actual local VCF or FASTA panel or a verified data path; it must not claim the package bundles the full resource.

# Agent-Safe Takeaways

- Real haplotype panels preserve empirical allele-frequency and LD patterns better than a toy random panel.
- Population structure and source accession metadata are important for analysis design.
- Reference data require version, coordinate build, sample filter, and chromosome selection provenance.

# Inputs to Specify

- Downloaded and filtered panel data
- Reference genome build
- Selected accessions and chromosome intervals

# Expected Outputs

- Local subset panel
- Sample metadata
- Provenance and filtering record

# Limitations and Guardrails

- A full public resource may be too large for package distribution.
- Panel use is subject to resource terms and correct coordinate/build handling.

# Questions This Record Can Ground

- What must a user provide to simulate from Arabidopsis 1001 Genomes data?
- Why is a real panel preferred for empirical LD?
